review_scope: Read-only visual and source review of revised background, sequential motion, RDF, learned selection, and appendix navigation.

checks.name: background_sequence
checks.evidence: Pages 4–6 separately introduce CLF, CBF, and their QP combination; page 7 connects the background to the research question. No forced takeaway on the three explanation pages.

checks.name: selective_takeaway_information
checks.evidence: Direct and Sequential first definitions remain in source. Pages 12–13 explicitly retain tolerance-based transition and release of link 1 task. Page 19 retains capsule versus RDF roles.

checks.name: motion_fixed_layout
checks.evidence: Pages 12–14 preserve robot viewpoint, obstacle positions, CLF plot area, constraint area, and common safety-condition placement. Stage captions remain legible and clear of the footer.

checks.name: learning_fixed_layout
checks.evidence: Pages 27–28 preserve encoder and attention node positions; the second frame adds selection and the control row. Arrows connect intended box anchors without text intersections.

checks.name: progress_readability
checks.evidence: Reviewed body pages show six navigation labels, current section highlighted, a continuous thin bar, and correct main slide count /33. No observed footer/content overlap.

checks.name: appendix_navigation
checks.evidence: Page 34 shows Backup and 1/17 with no main progress bar or section labels.

limitations: Review targets the requested rendered audience pages and relevant source; it does not repeat the controller numerical audit or inspect every presenter-note page.
